Sandbox_CPI_V1_HeavyDutyOffroadAdvantage: Share of off-road and forest grip loss recovered by Heavy-Duty or explicitly off-road-capable vehicles. Does not affect dry asphalt.
Sandbox_CPI_V1_HeavyDutyRainAdvantagePer: Share of rain grip loss recovered by Heavy-Duty or explicitly off-road-capable vehicles. Does not affect dry asphalt.
Sandbox_CPI_V1_HeavyDutySnowAdvantagePer: Share of snow grip loss recovered by Heavy-Duty or explicitly off-road-capable vehicles. Does not affect dry asphalt.
Sandbox_CPI_V1_HeavyDutyOffroadResistanc: Off-road rolling resistance retained by the terrain profile. Lower values improve progress through dirt, grass and forest. Does not affect asphalt.
Sandbox_CPI_V1_TerrainHandlingInfluenceP: How strongly rain, snow and off-road surfaces affect native Bullet wheel friction. Heavy-Duty retains more grip through its advantages. Does not affect dry asphalt or override the stricter active-drift limit.
Sandbox_CPI_V1_SlideMechanics: Enable drift and natural skid mechanics
Sandbox_CPI_V1_PowerDriftRotation_toolti: Yaw strength generated directly from the current steering input during power drift and clutch kick. BVD-like baseline: 2000.
Sandbox_CPI_V1_HandbrakeDriftRotation_to: Yaw strength generated directly from the current steering input while the handbrake slide is active. BVD-like baseline: 2000.
Sandbox_CPI_V1_PowerDriftGripPercent_too: Temporary wheel-friction level during power drift and clutch kick. Lower values produce a longer, looser slide.
Sandbox_CPI_V1_HandbrakeDriftGripPercent: Temporary wheel-friction level during handbrake drift. Lower values make the rear break away more easily.
Sandbox_CPI_V1_DriftSteeringPercent_tool: Steering multiplier only while an intentional slide is actively sustained. 100%% disables the extra drift steering boost.
